rubrics.title: Lab 10 — Analyze Your Twitter/X Data with Python

criteria.description: Lecture Exercises — lecture10.ipynb: CRUD in lec9.dummy_data and verification of the unchanged 100-record baseline (12 points): temporary insert, existing/nested-field update, new scalar and list fields, list-item update, exact-ID delete. Three AI-query exercises (6 points each): Fairfax post ranking, distinct-user maximum follower ranking, and nested hashtag occurrences. Each includes Markdown question and actual query, full Python export, initial DataFrame, Gemini-assisted final table/chart, and a brief finding. Use df_posts, df_users, df_tags. Keep executed outputs. No separate AI Use or Summary required in lecture; no saved Lab 9 query dependency.

Independent Questions — lab10.ipynb: Q1–Q4, 10 points each, read-only on the student's own lab8.tweet_collection. Each question has Markdown heading, actual MongoDB query in a fenced Markdown block, complete executable Python export with Include Driver Syntax, generic list(result)/pd.json_normalize conversion, initial df_q1–df_q4 display, required final output, and Markdown findings. Q1: up to ten unique most-liked tweets, complete text/likes table. Q2: up to ten distinct most-followed users, horizontal bar chart. Q3: non-empty profile locations counted by distinct users, bar chart. Q4: stored hashtag occurrences, bar chart. Preserve original counting, tie, missing-value, and case rules. Correctly executed and explained empty results are acceptable; failed/unexecuted queries are not empty results. No CRUD, new collection, prompt transcript, or saved Lab 9 query required.

AI Use — lab10.ipynb only: identify approved tools actually used, relevant questions/tasks, specific limitations and checks/corrections, and honestly attribute adapted lecture code. Approved tools: MongoDB built-in AI and Gemini inside Colab only. Do not fabricate AI interactions; no prompt transcript or credentials. Contact the instructor if an approved feature is unavailable. Confirmed unapproved AI use is governed by the assignment-wide zero-score policy, not just this criterion.

Summary — lab10.ipynb only: approximately 4–6 Markdown sentences synthesizing at least two actual findings, an important limitation of the collected dataset, and what the MongoDB-to-Python-to-pandas workflow enabled. Do not merely repeat all four answers or generalize the sample to all Twitter/X activity.

Submission & Source Access: exactly two values on separate lines in private Canvas: assigned GitHub repository root URL and complete working MongoDB connection string. Both lecture10.ipynb and lab10.ipynb at repository root on main, accessible to instructor, saved directly from Colab with executed outputs, Created using Colab message, and working Open in Colab button. Credentials only in Colab Secrets/private Canvas. Existing credential-exposure policy remains a separate one-time 20-point deduction from otherwise earned score, floored at zero; do not double-deduct under this criterion for the same exposure.
